rule.title: RRB-1099-R box 4 is fully taxable when box 3 is blank

citation.wording: If this box is blank, it means that the amount of your NSSEB and tier 2 payments shown in box 4 is fully taxable.

rule.open_point: Where box 3 prints employee contributions, box 4 is partly tax free and the Simplified Method (computation pension-taxable-not-determined) works the taxable part, so box 4 is counted 0.00 here. The CPA's 1099-R default (count the gross, assumed taxable) would count it in full instead — for the CPA to confirm.
